import sympy

# Sequence definition
a1 = 10
def next_a(n, a_n):
    # a_{n+1} = 6a_n - 2^{n+2} - 3^{n+1} + 5
    # Here n is the index of the current term (a_n), so we use n for the exponent calculations.
    # When calculating a_{n+1}, the index for n in the formula is actually n (the current index).
    return 6 * a_n - (2**(n + 2)) - (3**(n + 1)) + 5

terms = {}
terms[1] = a1

# Calculate a2 through a5
for n in range(1, 5):
    a_n_plus_1 = next_a(n, terms[n])
    terms[n+1] = a_n_plus_1

print("First 5 terms:", terms)

# Calculate prime factorizations
factorizations = {}
for i in range(1, 6):
    n = terms[i]
    factors = sympy.factorint(n)
    factorizations[i] = factors

print("\nPrime Factorizations:")
for i, factors in factorizations.items():
    print(f"a_{i} = {terms[i]} -> {factors}")
